lastCommit.message:
OTA-1829 — the top plane stops going black

The owner gave a repro a device can reproduce: the exploration row where
STORE sits beside FUSE CRUCIBLE, and the three-button STORE / TALK / GIFT
row — "when you hit the store button the top of it disappears."

He is right, and OTA-1828 walked straight past it. That pass censused
BORDER PAIRS and pronounced 154 ctl controls correct. Every one of those
claims was true and none was sufficient, because the visible top edge of a
planed control is not its border — it is controlPlaneTop, a 2dp absolutely
positioned band of controlFaceLit. The defect lived one layer above where
the census was looking.

THE MECHANISM. Pressed, controlPlaneTopPressed painted that band with
controlSidewall, a two-thirds-opaque black, over a face that is already
near-black. It composites to the face, so the top piece does not darken,
it VANISHES. That is ~250 planed controls across 54 files — every screen
in the game, not one screen.

AND IT IS WHY THE CHARACTER SCREEN WAS THE AUTHORITY. The dossier wears no
planes at all; it inverts border colours only, so its top edge is always
drawn. The authority never had the defect and everything else always had
it. No per-screen patching would have found that, because it was never
per-screen.

THE REPAIR IS ONE SHARED STYLE. The light MOVES instead of switching off:
the pressed top band drops to controlLit — an existing token, 0.20 against
the resting 0.38 — while the pressed bottom band takes the full
controlFaceLit. Every geometry cue Phase 2 bought survives: the band still
grows 2dp to 3dp, the sidewall still collapses, the contact band is still
not drawn, the control still travels 3dp. Nothing minted, no idle
appearance moved, and the only difference is DURING a press.

Two Phase-2 pins asserted the old spelling and are AMENDED, not deleted:
each pinned "the pressed top band is that exact black", which is the half
that was the defect. Their load-bearing claims — the light moves to the
lower edge, the side loses height — are unchanged and one is now asserted
more strictly than before.

22/22 gates, typecheck:ci clean, lint clean, test typecheck 180 (no
change), 185 suites / 2773 tests green. Negative control: restoring the
black band turns exactly the three repair pins red and leaves all eight
guard-rails green; restored with md5 match.

That the pressed band READS on a real panel is the owner's eye on
hardware; this suite reads construction, not pixels.
